exercise.rubric: <font color="#000000">Match the descriptions with the words on the right.</font>

questions.sentence: <font color="#000000">An agreement by the seller to replace or repair damaged goods </font>[warranty]</font>
<font color="#000000">A group of things (products) that are sold together </font>[batch]
<font color="#000000">An agreement that the cost of something will not change </font>[fixed price]
<font color="#000000">An exact description of a product </font>[specifications]
<font color="#000000">A time when companies can tender for a product or service </font>[bidding period]
<font color="#000000">The transportation of goods by train, boat, plane, road, etc. </font>[shipping]
<font color="#000000">The amount of money that is available for something </font>[budget]
